responsibility: Defines rustc's generic-argument and substitution representation, including the compact interned `GenericArg`/`GenericArgKind` model, interned substitution lists, and binder-aware substitution logic that instantiates generic type, lifetime, and const parameters into `ty` values while correctly shifting escaping bound variables. It also carries user-specified path substitutions and self-type information used to represent explicitly written generic arguments during type checking.
